input.rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own home (hardwood floor, drywall, contents) caused by a burst supply line in their own plumbing is a straightforward property damage claim.

Estimated damage of $8,000–$15,000 falls within the medium range ($2,000–$25,000); extensive hardwood and drywall damage plus ruined contents, but no injuries and well within the $750,000 policy limit.

input.claim_summary: Policyholder Sam Patel (POL-1004) returned from a work trip to find basement flooded with approximately two inches of water caused by a burst supply line under the upstairs bathroom sink that ran for approximately two days. Damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, water-soaked drywall (up to one foot height), and ruined stored items. Estimated damage $8,000–$15,000. $500 deductible applies.
